triage.note: The near side of the Item 12 boundary, and the reason that boundary needs a date rather than a single alias. Release 33-8048's equity-compensation-plan suffix binds annual reports for fiscal years ending on or after 2002-03-15; this filing's period ends 2001-12-29, ten weeks before it, so its canonical Item 12 caption is the unsuffixed one. MEASURED PRE-FIX (2026-08-20): item 5 title 'Market for the Registrant's Common Stock and Related Stockholder Matters', item 12 title 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management and Related Stockholder Matters', item 13 title 'Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence' -- the same three defects as ge-1994, eight years later, which is what makes them table defects rather than a 1993-only artifact. This fixture is the LOWER bracket of the Item 12 boundary; gs-2002 (period end 2002-11-29) and intc-2002 (2002-12-28) are the upper bracket and both write the suffixed caption in their own headings, so the corpus constrains the boundary to the interval (2001-12-29, 2002-11-29] and 2002-03-15 is the only rule date inside it.
